what_this_is: Per-coordinate rank of the RAW local contrast matrix for every recorded D6 counterexample world.  n_misaligned counts the coordinates where raw rank one FAILS while centred rank one may still hold; those are exactly the coordinates that the centred invariant cannot see.
what_this_is_not: Not a recomputation of the decision layer.  delta_square and the doubled decision gap are read from the annotated artifacts and are labelled source=artifact_recorded.
mu_caveat: mu_i is reported only where the centred profile is nonzero.  Where the context factor is constant, lambda is not determined by F and mu carries no information; those coordinates are flagged context_factor_degenerate and excluded from sum_mu_max_abs.
